title: How to Apply for a PWD ID in the Philippines
description: Access mandated discounts and government assistance for persons with disabilities.

requirements.title: Medical Certificate
requirements.description: A certificate from a licensed physician indicating the diagnosis and type of disability.

requirements.title: Valid ID
requirements.description: A government-issued ID for identity verification.

requirements.title: ID Photo
requirements.description: Recent 1x1 or 2x2 photograph of the applicant.

requirements.title: Proof of Residency
requirements.description: Documents verifying your residence in the city or municipality.

checklist.title: Secure Medical Cert
checklist.description: Visit a physician for a medical evaluation and obtain a certificate clearly stating your diagnosis.

checklist.title: Prepare IDs
checklist.description: Gather your valid government IDs and personal information for the application.

checklist.title: Complete Form
checklist.description: Fill out the PWD application form provided by your local PDAO or social welfare office.

checklist.title: Submit Requirements
checklist.description: Present your documents to the PDAO office at your City or Municipal Hall for review.

checklist.title: Wait for Approval
checklist.description: Allow for the assessment and verification process, which varies by local government unit.

checklist.title: Claim ID
checklist.description: Receive your PWD ID and discount purchase booklet once approved.

blocks.content: A **PWD ID** is an official identification card issued to qualified Persons with Disability (PWDs) in the Philippines through the local government unit (LGU) and Persons with Disability Affairs Office (PDAO). ([ncda.gov.ph](https://ncda.gov.ph/disability-laws/republic-acts/republic-act-no-10754/))
The card certifies that the holder is recognized as a Person with Disability under Philippine law and is entitled to specific government-mandated benefits and privileges.
The PWD ID is commonly used for:

items: Discounts on medicines and medical services

blocks.content: Qualified applicants also receive a purchase booklet for monitoring discounts and VAT exemptions.
You may apply for a PWD ID if you have a long-term physical, mental, intellectual, or sensory impairment that substantially affects daily activities.

For the latest PWD laws and nationwide guidelines, visit:
- [National Council on Disability Affairs (NCDA)](https://ncda.gov.ph)
- [Department of Health (DOH) PWD Registry](https://pwd.doh.gov.ph)
For actual applications, please visit your local **Persons with Disability Affairs Office (PDAO)** at your City or Municipal Hall.
The application itself is usually free, although applicants may still pay for medical certificates and document preparation.
PWD IDs are generally issued by the local government unit through the PDAO or social welfare office.

blocks.title: Can mental health conditions qualify for a PWD ID?

blocks.content: Yes. Certain psychosocial disabilities and mental health conditions may qualify subject to medical evaluation. ([ncda.gov.ph](https://ncda.gov.ph/disability-laws/republic-acts/republic-act-no-9442/))

blocks.title: Is the PWD ID accepted nationwide?

blocks.content: Yes. Valid PWD IDs issued by authorized LGUs are generally recognized nationwide.

blocks.title: Can someone else apply on behalf of a PWD?

blocks.content: Yes, provided authorization and supporting documents are submitted.
Policies vary by LGU. Some IDs may require periodic renewal or record updates.
